source_row.rationale: Calcimimetics like cinacalcet work by increasing the sensitivity of calcium-sensing receptors on the parathyroid gland, reducing parathyroid hormone secretion, used to manage secondary hyperparathyroidism common in CKD.
source_row.source_detail: Mechanism of Action as a Calcimimetic
